# Kautusan No. 3, Series of 1990

**An Ordinance of the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon, for the General Fund for the Year 1991**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance appropriates funds from the General Fund and Infrastructure Fund of Pitogo, Quezon for the fiscal year 1991. It allocates funds for various expenses and projects as determined by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]]. The ordinance was enacted on August 20, 1990.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Seksyon 1.** Appropriates funds from the General Fund amounting to P1,835,325.77 and from the Infrastructure Fund amounting to P439,889.62.
2.  **Seksyon 2.** Specifies that the funds from the General Fund and Infrastructure Fund for the year 1991 will be used to cover expenses related to the Laang-Gugulin as detailed in Annexes "A" and "B".
3.  **Seksyon 3.** States that the ordinance will take effect on January 1, 1991.
4.  **Seksyon 4.** Declares the ordinance to be in effect starting August 20, 1990.
